name: Turso landing page by turso.tech
description: A dark, near-black developer landing page built almost entirely from typography, terminal-style code windows and thin-bordered cards, with a single teal/mint accent used sparingly for CTAs, links and one glowing illustration. The hero pairs a bold statement headline with a live code snippet, then the page alternates rhythm: a manifesto section with a diagram, a five-column numbered property grid, code demo, customer stories in bordered cards, enterprise compliance, a two-path open-source/cloud split, a community section with pill-labelled cards, and a CTA closed by a playful green database illustration. The restraint is the point: no stock photos, no gradients (except the final illustration), density controlled by generous whitespace and consistent hairline card borders.
